about_the_game:
Buttons:

↑↓←→，Z（enter or controller A），X（esc or controller B）, Menu called out by the controller: Y

Game background:

The Devil king, having just depleted his power, suddenly became the target of everyone's ire in the entire world!?

Hero,

"Hero, hero, hero, Devil King, hero, hero, hero.".

In order to vanquish the Devil King, countless brave warriors rushed towards the Devil King's castle!

Keep going and keep living... Lord Devil King.

Game Features:

  • Grow and prepare for battle in seven-day cycles

  • An endless battle, but depending on the number of rounds held, retiring can reveal multiple different endings

  • Only operate and make decisions within the scope of the Devil King Castle

  • Eighteen types of heroes will be randomly paired into four-person teams, potentially resulting in thousands of hero combinations?

  • There are 24 types of subordinates, and 4 of them can be dispatched randomly each round, bringing different disturbances to the hero team. If the same subordinate appears multiple times .....

  • The skills(118 types) and equipment(300+ types) obtainable in each round are all contained in the random pool. Will the encounter with the hero be easy or challenging?

  • By the way, there are also mysterious enemies While luck favors you, use tactics to defeat them!

If you suddenly have bad luck after a few rounds and don't want to lose the current round, mysterious code: 99519951. Once you enter the game, you will know where it is used, Lord Devil King.
